sentences.text: Though matter is listed for non-production of settlement copy, learned counsel for respondents no.1 to 3- claimants produced copy of order sheet in Execution Petition No.7/2017, wherein compromise is entered into between claimants and owner regarding quantum of compensation and liability.
It was also submitted that in terms of compromise, claimants had received entire compensation and therefore, sought for disposal of appeal.
3. Submission is not countenanced by either counsel for insurer or appellant-owner.
4. In view of above, appeal is disposed of as being infructuous in view of settlement between owner and claimants with regard to subject matter of appeal in Execution proceedings.
Amount in deposit is ordered to be refunded to appellant.
